one_month_reasoning: The Q3 2026 results date is NOT company-confirmed: no 8-K or release as of 2026-10-05 (EDGAR list, latest 8-K 2026-08-12); Yahoo lists 2026-10-29 with isEarningsDateEstimate=false but that is a vendor flag, MarketBeat calls it unconfirmed (est. Oct 29) and TipRanks/Investing list Wed Nov 4 after the close, which would put the reaction outside the window. Reddit's own pattern (Q3'25 Thu Oct 30, Q1'26 Thu Apr 30, Q2'26 Thu Jul 30) favours Thu Oct 29, so I put ~60% on the earnings gap landing inside the window. If it lands: guide $860-870M / $385-395M adj EBITDA, consensus $872M; Reddit beat the top of guide by 9.7% (Q1) and 11.0% (Q2), so revenue ~$930-950M is likely, but the stock trades on users (Q2: -21% next day despite the beat on a flat QoQ US DAUq) and Q3 is the first quarter without the logged-in/out split. No directional edge: median at spot. Ladder = 60% lognormal at 22% monthly sigma (earnings month) + 40% at 13.5% (no event), i.e. ~19% effective, close to the 70%/3.5 = 20% base.

The case for one is measurable (CY27 revenue growth +32% vs peer median +13%; adj EBITDA margin ~45% with capex ~0.1% of revenue; $2.8B cash, no debt), but persistence through Oct-2027 is not proven: US DAUq is flat QoQ, the 10-Q cites search-engine algorithm changes, only $30.1M of licensing RPO is contracted for 2027, and the logged-in/out split is being dropped. Those risks plausibly offset the growth gap, so the median is the honest multiple. Round 1's 25x on taxed GAAP EPS against a mixed-basis 19.0x median was an unproven ~40% premium and is withdrawn.

reasoning: Round 2. Fundamentals from filings are unchanged and the supervisor verified them (Q2'26 revenue $805M +61%, adj EBITDA 43%, Q3 guide $860-870M/$385-395M, $2.79B cash, no debt, 207.0M diluted shares, $760.4M buyback left, GAAP tax $5.7M on $462.6M H1 pretax, licensing RPO $30.1M for 2027). What changed is valuation discipline. I rebuilt the peer table on one basis (Yahoo CY2027 street EPS for 10 December-year peers; SNAP swapped to its adjusted $0.78; SPOT EPS converted from EUR). Re-checking the supervisor's FX, EUR/USD on 2026-10-05 is 1.1212, not ~1.17, so SPOT is 27.9x not 26.7x; the median is 18.2x (supervisor's 9-peer 17.6x excludes MGNI). I also note the supervisor's tax arithmetic mixes conventions (CY27 $8.2 taxes only GAAP pretax, CY28 $10.15 taxes all adjusted pretax); I tax all adjusted pretax at 22% in both years, the peer non-GAAP convention, giving $8.15/$10.36. I drop round 1's 25x premium and apply the median 18.2x to taxed NTM adjusted EPS $9.81 = $178.5; FCF yield raised from 4% to 5% = $176; GAAP cross-check 22x x $7.28 = $160; blend $174 (round 1 $200). My CY26 base is trimmed to ~$3.50B (smaller beat assumption) and CY27 is only ~2% above consensus. Scenarios $100 (25%) / $175 (50%) / $250 (25%) have a mean of $175, reconciling with the $174 fair value. The ladder blends a scenario mixture (each scenario lognormal, sigma 0.28) with a single lognormal (mean $175, sigma 0.55, below 70% realised vol which is inflated by earnings gaps), with slightly fatter tails: median ~$157, P(>=$152) 0.53, P(<$106) ~22% vs bear weight 25%. The Q3 date is unconfirmed, so the 1-month ladder weights the earnings gap at ~60% inside the window, centred at spot. S&P 500 inclusion (effective 2026-08-18, per supervisor) is already done, so no index-add catalyst. Research ~8 queries this round; no option data used.
